title: Formalize normal-class rank and complete count/price bounds in Lean
body:
PR #2338's all-batch P112 argument uses a normal-class rank implication that had not been kernel-checked here. This contribution formalizes that implication, its rectangular fixed-space transfer and its complete count/price consequences, with the exact premises exposed.

For any field and finite term set, distinct endpoint classes and `K[i,j] != 0 -> beta[i] = alpha[j]` imply `2 dim ker(I-K) <= t`. For rectangular factors with `AC+DE=I_N`, the same hypotheses on `CA` give `2N <= 2n+t`; charging every term yields `64k+3t <= 7t+8n` when `N=8k`, plus the real-power analogue. The proof includes empty term sets. Explicit counterexamples show why equal classes, zero diagonal alone and a one-third replacement fail.

The source mathematics belongs to DreamingOfClouds' #2338, pinned at `82700676e1d42acf98dc1921cb6ef82551620008`; exact README/NOTICE copies and hashes are retained. #2342 supplies a narrower independent three-call argument and explicitly excludes auditing the broader all-batch proof. This PR does **not** verify the geometric/frame premises, run the source SAT/DRAT rigidity check, audit all of #2338 or admit a physical supplier. Selected certificates and kappa are unchanged.

Validation performed locally:

- Fresh Lean 4.33.0-rc1 / pinned Mathlib build: 26 actual axiom probes, only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; three false proof attempts rejected after valid imports.
- Independent fraction and binary rank engines: 39,157 labelled compatible matrices in Q and F2, both orientation minors, nine rectangular fixture cases and an abstract sharp complete factorization.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay and nine fault-control groups passed.
- Full kernel replay under optimized Python 3.14 from a Git-free, read-only 20-file execution snapshot produced an identical kernel receipt; all nine control groups passed and the snapshot was unchanged. This caught and fixed inherited read-only permissions on the new build directory.
- Scoped workflow executes the actual Lean build; hosted CI success is not claimed by the local receipt.

Replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/lean-normal-class-rank`. That default checks sources/finite evidence and explicitly does not run Lean. README documents the separate full kernel command; VALIDATION.json records the executed checks and their limits.

One fresh random draw selected independent-verification, second suggestion `formal-interface-lemma`; TASK.json records the scope change and no reroll. Canonical main remained `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Final overlap covered 607 open PRs and 1,137 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings.

Coordination: #2380. Open next question: formally bind the actual P112 normal-class/frame evidence to the matrix compatibility premise.

Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, verification and writing; no subagents or independent human review. Wrapper/workflow/control structure adapts our #2341/#2295 harnesses, with attribution. New finite engines import no predecessor checker.
